One team for the cake, the setting and the food.

Blerad Event plans, designs and bakes for celebrations of every size. You tell us the occasion and the mood, and we take care of the details so you can enjoy the day with your guests.

From a single custom cake to a full wedding with décor, catering and an MC, we handle it with the same care.

8+years creating events and cakes people still talk about.

Everything your event needs

  • Custom cakes

    Wedding, birthday and engagement cakes designed to match your theme, colours and taste.

  • Event planning

    From the first idea to the last guest leaving, we organise the schedule, vendors and flow.

  • Décor and styling

    Tables, aisles, tents and venues dressed in flowers, drapes and lighting.

  • Balloons

    Arches, garlands and balloon sets for birthdays, showers and welcome parties.

  • Backdrops

    Photo-ready stages and walls for the high table, the couple and the cake.

  • Rentals

    Chairs, tables, canopies, linens and table settings delivered and set up.

  • Catering

    Party rice, grilled chicken, small chops, drinks and fruit, packed and served well.

  • MC and entertainment

    A host to keep the programme moving and your guests having fun.
